scope: Read-only audit of Sagittarius geometry against the actual native panel source and manufacturing ZIP. This does not replace supplier CAM approval.

inputs.gerber_coordinate_conversion: Native and Gerber use the same upward Y coordinates; design_panel_y = 100 − Gerber_y_mm

assembly_projection.mirror: X coordinate mirrored in assembly-local coordinates
assembly_projection.note: The actual exported aperture union is projected through the 30 mm rounded windows after assembly-local X mirroring.

manufactured_webs.limitation: Webs are computed from the exported GKO cutout contours and NPTH drills; supplier routing compensation and actual cutter behavior are not represented.

material_connectivity.note: Connected-material check subtracts the manufactured apertures from the Sagittarius board outline polygon.

silkscreen.limitation: Gerber stroke reconstruction uses round-buffered centerline paths; generated line-cap geometry approximates the CAM raster. A supplier preview remains the final check.

manufacturing_limits: The shortest routed slot e14 is 1.489 mm end to end (0.489 mm centerline travel); supplier CAM must confirm it can be routed with the nominal 1.000 mm cutter.
This is a file-level geometry audit. It does not establish color-silkscreen process coverage, optical transmission, or sample performance.
